title: Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi

paragraphs: In Chullin 19b Rav Nachman came to Sura and they asked him; he said to them: “Is this not what Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi said — that slaughtering done like a comb is valid?” Hyman infers from this that he was older than Rav Nachman.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Chullin 19b explicitly names Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi. The conclusion that he was older than Rav Nachman is Hyman’s inference, not a dated generation established by the quotation.

Chullin 19b explicitly names Rabbi Elazar bar Minyomi in Rav Nachman’s answer at Sura. Hyman’s conclusion that he was older than Rav Nachman remains an inference from the report, not a newly established generation or date.
